episodes.title: Zolita Escapes a Cult
episodes.description: Zolita & Devon bond over surviving a Kundalini cult. Zolita accidentally gives herself lip filler at Berghain, and teaches us how to find romance on the dance floor. In the pregame, Devon sends a break-up text, and Elle dallies in feminism. Follow us on: YouTube: / @partygodpod Instagram: / partygodpod TikTok: / partygodpod
